$comment: The renderer CONFORMANCE matrix (packages/exponential-ui/conformance): every fixture × theme × mode × width × direction is laid out by the React renderer in headless Chromium and by the gpui painter headless (gpui's cosmic-text system), both with the font set of `fonts`, and dumped as frames (conformance/dump.ts). `kitchen-sink` = fixtures/kitchen-sink.json with the React harness's data; `responsive` = the kitchen sink's responsive section exactly as layout-geometry-round1.json frames it (its `surface` + `data`), but REAL text instead of the fixed measure. The case's direction replaces the root's `direction` style. `textComponents` = the components whose `lines` both sides report (the leaves that lay out a plain text block). Tolerances: every node ±`px` on x/y/w/h; a node with text lines on either side may differ by `textLines` line heights in height (the wrap tolerance) — everything else is a divergence. Paths are repo-relative.
